CommunityApplications.Profile: Reusable audio applications for Unraid, including CamillaDSP-based equalization and configurable Spotify Connect playback. Templates contain no user credentials, fixed IP addresses, or installation-specific identifiers.
Backyard audio applications for Unraid, including CamillaDSP-based professional equalization and Spotify Connect playback. Source, documentation, and support are maintained in this public repository.
